info.headline: Flood Advisory issued September 26 at 2:55AM CDT until September 26 at 5:45AM CDT by NWS Amarillo TX
info.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.
* WHERE...Western Randall County in the panhandle of Texas...
* WHEN...Until 545 AM CDT.
* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas. Water over roadways.
* ADDITIONAL DETAILS... - At 255 AM CDT, Doppler radar and automated rain gauges indicated heavy rain due to thunderstorms. Minor flooding is ongoing or expected to begin shortly in the advisory area. Between 2 and 3 inches of rain have fallen. - Additional rainfall amounts up to 0.3 inches are expected over the area. This additional rain will result in minor flooding. - Some locations that will experience flooding include... Canyon, Umbarger, Mescalero Park and Buffalo Lake. - http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
info.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood deaths occur in vehicles.
Be especially cautious at night when it is harder to recognize the dangers of flooding.
